banglaExplanation: ক্লাস শুরুর আগে জানতে হবে ট্রেইনি এখন কী পারে, একেই pre assessment বলে।
দুইভাবে করা যায়: সরাসরি learner-এর সাথে checking, আর pre session information analyse করা।
Checking মানে self assessment instrument, oral interview বা written test।
এতে বোঝা যায় training-এর best starting point কোথায়, ফলে সময় নষ্ট হয় না।

example.bn: Welding কোর্সের আগে self-assessment checklist-এ Yes/No টিক দেওয়া হয়।
example.en: Before a welding course, each trainee ticks Yes or No for every performance criterion. The trainer reads the CV too.

viva.prompt: Why give a pre-self assessment before the session?

realQuestions.answer:
Trainees' current competency can be determined by pre-assessment.
The following are suggested methods you can use to pre-assess a trainee's
competencies.
1. Checking with the learner.
When you meet the trainee (first time), you can ask the learner to respond or
undergo a self-assessment instrument or subject them to an oral interview or
written test.
2. Analyse any pre-session information available, like enrolment form or -pre-
application form and other related documents such as;
•
Reports of previous competency assessment undertaken.
•
Resume or Curriculum Vitae.
•
Enterprise training and assessment records.
•
Performance Reports from Supervisor.
Answer 2
Trainee's training requirements or training needs can be determined by identifying
the gap between the required competencies as defined by the unit of competency
and the trainee's current competency.
The gap between the required competencies and the current competencies is the
portion of the skills and knowledge the learner needs to achieve to be recognized as
competent in a particular job.
Answer 3
The learner training requirements can be validated with the following
persons/officers.
•
Trainers, Teachers and Assessors.
•
Supervisors/ or trainees employers.
•
Participant Trainee/Learner who is advanced in skill.
•
Experts in the Trainees Trade Areas.
•
Government Regulatory bodies.
•
Consultative Committees.
•
Training Providers, employers and human resources departments.
•
Assessors/Assessment Centers.
Answer 4
A competency standard includes:
•
skills, knowledge and attitude requirements for the level of work
•
quality indicators
•
national qualifications that a person can receive who has been assessed as
competent against the national standards
•
learning strategies that provide guidance about the organisation of training,
including implementation guidelines and training/learning materials
•
assessment guidelines
•
assessment methods and materials
Answer 5
As mentioned above, a competency standard provides information about the
competencies associated with different occupations within a particular industry. They
ideally lead to national qualifications and include assessment guidelines.
A curriculum document serves as an implementation guide for a unit of competency
or course or module of study. For a curriculum document to be accepted by the
industries, it must be 'mapped' against the competencies in competency standards.
At this stage though, there are still many industries that do not have industry
competency standards developed.
Basically, competency standards establish the skills, knowledge and attitude required
for a particular industry. A curriculum interprets the competency standards so that it
can be delivered as a course in TVET institutions.
